source.label: Bally Time Tunnel factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Time Tunnel revolves around stopping and collecting a cycling 1,000–5,000 tunnel value. Time the plunge so the tunnel timer switch freezes 5,000 before the ball reaches the top center collect lane. During play, collect values of 3,000 or more through that lane, the left return chute, or an open gate.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Time Tunnel, time the plunge so the shooter-lane tunnel timer switch freezes the value at 5,000, then reach the top center lane to collect it. During play, collect 3,000 or more at the center target, left chute, top lane, or either open gate; use the upper playfield to change low values.
strategy.summary: A low tunnel value is not worth forcing at the dangerous center standup. Send the ball up top, use the start-tunnel saucers to change it, and collect a favorable value through safer lanes or gates whenever possible.

quickInfo.name: Tunnel timer switch
quickInfo.summary: A switch near the top of the shooter lane freezes the cycling tunnel value.

quickInfo.name: Collect tunnel
quickInfo.summary: The top center lane, center standup, left chute, and open gate lanes collect the stopped value.

quickInfo.name: Start tunnel saucers
quickInfo.summary: The two top saucers restart or change the tunnel value and open their matching gates.

quickInfo.name: Target value
quickInfo.summary: Collect 3,000–5,000; use upper-playfield action to change 1,000 or 2,000.

steps.text: Watch the tunnel lamps, then plunge so the shooter-lane switch stops the value at 5,000 before the ball reaches the top center lane.
Collect the stopped value through the top center lane if the plunge continues cleanly.
During play, take the center collect target only with a controlled, slightly off-center hit and a value of at least 3,000.
At 1,000 or 2,000, shoot up top and use a start-tunnel saucer to change the value and open a gate.
Prefer the left collect chute or either open gate over a dangerous center-target attempt.
Collect it through a safe lane, chute, gate, or controlled center hit.
Restart a low value up top and repeat.

machineSetup: Confirm Extra Ball and Special conversion, then watch one full tunnel-light cycle and identify whether the stop switch responds consistently to plunge timing.
Test the tunnel timer switch, top center collect lane, both start-tunnel saucers and gates, left collect chute and return, center collect standup, tunnel lamps, and all gate switches.
